# Umoja Network
> Affordable uncapped 5G home internet for South African communities.

Umoja bridges the digital divide by delivering fast, unlimited 5G home internet to underserved communities across South Africa. Customers can check coverage, apply online, and get connected with a single router — no contracts, no throttling.

## Key pages
- / — home page and service overview
- /coverage — interactive coverage checker (enter your address to see if 5G is available)
- /application — primary signup flow for new customers
- /online — online product landing page

## Business context
- Service area: South Africa (currently expanding)
- Product: Uncapped 5G home internet via fixed-wireless router
- Target audience: Households and small businesses in underserved South African communities
- Referral programme: Customers can refer others and earn rewards
- Reseller programme: Community resellers can sign up partners using personalised links
